items.title: Building Custom Batched Ensemble Weather Forecasting with NVIDIA Earth2Studio

items.title: Vercel AI Open-Sources vgpu: A TypeScript WebGPU Library for AI Agent Shaders
items.summary: Vercel has open-sourced vgpu, the WebGPU library it built to ship the shaders on vercel.com. It treats .wgsl files as importable TypeScript modules, runs the same shader in the browser, in headless Node.js via Dawn, and in a deterministic CI mock, and ships a fullscreen effect in 25 KB gzipped.

items.title: Google AI Releases Gemini 3.5 Transcribe: A Speech-to-Text Model Reporting 2.6% Average WER Across 85+ Languages
items.summary: Google has released Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, a speech-to-text model that ships as two separate endpoints rather than one. The streaming endpoint delivers sub-second transcription but drops speaker diarization and word timestamps. The batch endpoint keeps both, at half the cost.

items.title: Cohere Releases Parse 5 (parse-v5.0): A 2.3B Vision Language Model That Turns Enterprise Documents Into Markdown
items.summary: Cohere has released Parse (parse-v5.0), a 2.3B-parameter vision language model that converts PDFs, slides and images into Markdown with HTML tables, bounding boxes and image descriptions. It runs at $1.50 per 1,000 pages through the API, or on dedicated Model Vault instances from $2,500 a month.
